alt: Can a new customer understand your product in ten seconds?
Your first screen has one job. Show a new visitor what you sell, who it is for, and what to do next. Ten seconds is a test you run, not a research figure.
Six things to see: What it is; Who it's for; The price; Proof it's good; Delivery info; What to do next
Run the exercise: Open it on a phone - Your product page, first view.; Look, then look away - Give it about ten seconds.; Write what you recall - Gaps show what is unclear.
A candle shop. Unclear page: Photo, no price; Delivery in the footer. Clear page: Name, price and size on top; Delivery time near the button
Test with fresh eyes: Ask a new person - Someone who never saw the store.; Watch, don't explain - Let them find the answers alone.; Note what confuses - Don't defend it. Just write it down.
Before you publish: Product name is clear; Price is easy to see; Delivery info is easy to find; One clear button to press

Can a new customer understand your product in ten seconds? ⏱️

This is a simple exercise, not a research claim: open your product page on a phone, look at it for about ten seconds, then write down what you remember. Product, customer, price, proof, delivery and the next step should all be easy to spot.
